QuestInfo.name: [Daily Quest] Vanishing Journey Research
QuestInfo.0: The Vanishing Journey is a mysterious place where everything seems to be in a constant state of decay. You've agreed to help the Guardians of Time get to the bottom of this mystery. Help the Guardians of Time in their research by completing the mission they give you daily.
